svg.title: Sentiment index computation
svg.desc: Every scored pair is read with its bank, source and date, filtered to a window, weighted by source and confidence, grouped four ways, summarised with shrinkage toward neutral, and written. A volume floor applies later, when the chatbot reads a score.
